title: Starlight & Beacon
flavor: Beneath the night sky of Drodo Island, stardust cuts through the silent darkness. Starlight chases the glowing magic beacon, crossing shadowed wastes and barren lands. Travelers of all races entrust their wishes to the flickering lights. Guided by starlight and bound by sacred flames, every glimmer holds hope amid strife across this wondrous realm.

entries.name: Lucid Star
entries.detail: New relic. 20% chance to directly obtain a ★★ piece on purchase if you already own one.

entries.name: Defiant Shell
entries.detail: New relic. Reduces damage taken on home defeats or increases damage dealt on away-home victories by 1–10 based on your courier's lost health. Every 10% health lost adds 1 to the reduction or bonus, capped at 10.

entries.name: Weighted Dice
entries.detail: New relic. Refunds 1–2 random gold if you fail to recruit any owned chess piece. Consecutive recruitment failures gradually raise the chance of receiving 2 gold.

entries.name: Shroud of Concealment
entries.detail: Temporarily removed from the drop pool.

entries.name: Luna
entries.detail: Base attack interval reduced from 1.3s to 1.2s.

entries.name: Morphling — Morph
entries.detail: Attribute conversion threshold now uses standard rounding (was floor). First conversion HP threshold 99% → 94%.

entries.name: Naga — Scaled Armor
entries.detail: (2) grants allies 15% magic resistance. (4) grants allies 35% magic resistance. (6) when taking non-pure damage, reflect 1.5× the damage reduced by magic resistance.

entries.name: Undead & Pandaren
entries.detail: Sold Undead and Pandaren units no longer refill back into the chess pool (same rule as SSR units, IO, and monopolized units).

entries.name: Chess pool refill
entries.detail: Pieces not in the chess pool (Undead, Pandaren, etc.) no longer refill back to the pool after being sold.

entries.name: Round 1 prep time
entries.detail: 25s → 35s. Rounds 2–11 remain 25s; every other round is 35s.
